title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Colgate University
description: Late-night dining at Colgate University is defined by a mix of on-campus staples and village favorites in Hamilton. From the legendary 'Slices' to 24/7 automated kiosks, these spots provide essential fuel for late-night study sessions and social gatherings.

cards.title: The Legendary Slices Run
cards.subtitle: 39 Lebanon St, Hamilton
cards.notes: Order a plain slice at this Hamilton institution, a cornerstone of late-night culture for generations of Colgate students.
cards.short_summary: Known universally as 'Slices,' this pizzeria is the definitive late-night destination in the village of Hamilton.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Pizzeria (Slices) is open until 2:00 a.m. on Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: New York Pizzeria (Slices) - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 a.m. most nights; delivery is available after 8:00 p.m.

cards.title: Midnight at Frank
cards.subtitle: 13 Oak Drive, Hamilton
cards.notes: Visit the primary campus dining hall for late-night snacks and social breaks before the midnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: The Curtiss E. Frank Dining Hall serves as the central hub for student dining and late-night social interaction on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Frank Dining Hall is open from 6:30 a.m. to midnight during the week.
cards.source_title: Colgate's Dining Staff: The Heart Behind Colgate's Dining Halls - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight daily during the academic semester.

cards.title: Late-Night Boost at The Coop
cards.subtitle: 13 Oak Drive, Hamilton
cards.notes: Use the Boost app to order grill items and snacks for pickup during the dedicated late-night window.
cards.short_summary: The Coop offers a specialized late-night menu for students seeking quick bites in the center of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Late-night dining at the Coop is available from 8:00 p.m. to midnight daily via the Boost mobile app.
cards.access_notes: Late-night service runs from 8:00 p.m. to midnight.

cards.title: 24/7 Warm Food Kiosk
cards.subtitle: O'Connor Campus Center
cards.notes: Grab a warm White Castle burger or Cinnabon roll anytime from this automated vending machine in the Coop.
cards.short_summary: An automated 'Just Baked' kiosk provides 24/7 access to warm snacks, filling the gap after dining halls close.
cards.evidence_claim: An automated vending machine called Just Baked provides constant access to warm food in the O'Connor Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Dining Services Makes Student-Centered Changes for Fall 2024 - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Available 24/7 inside the O'Connor Campus Center.

cards.title: Library Study Fuel
cards.subtitle: Level 5, Case-Geyer Library
cards.notes: Access the 5th-floor café area for vending machine snacks and a 24/7 study environment during finals.
cards.short_summary: The Case-Geyer Library Café offers a 24/7 space for students to study and access vending machine refreshments.
cards.evidence_claim: Case-Geyer provides 24/7 study spaces on Level 5 in the Café with food and beverage machines.
cards.source_title: After Hours Access to Case-Geyer - Colgate University Libraries
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access to the Level 5 Café area with a valid student ID card.

cards.title: Fridays at Donnie's
cards.subtitle: Hall of Presidents
cards.notes: Enjoy late-night programming and pub fare at this campus social hub, which extends hours for weekend events.
cards.short_summary: Donovan's Pub, or 'Donnie's,' is a popular campus spot that hosts late-night events and offers a relaxed dining atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Donovan's Pub has extended hours for 'Fridays@Donnie's' events, running from 11:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Donovan's Pub Extends Hours and Adds Events - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Extended hours until 1:00 a.m. on select Friday nights for student events.

cards.title: The Stewart's Ice Cream Run
cards.subtitle: 2463 New York 12B, Hamilton
cards.notes: Head to Stewart's for a late-night pint of ice cream or a quick hot meal from the grab-and-go section.
cards.short_summary: A regional favorite, Stewart's Shops provides essential late-night convenience and ice cream for the Hamilton community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stewart's Shops location in Hamilton is open until 11:00 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Convenience Store and Gas Station in Hamilton | Stewart's Shops
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 5:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

cards.title: Byrne Dairy Deli Run
cards.subtitle: 169 Utica St, Hamilton
cards.notes: Stop by for a late-night sandwich or a slice of breakfast pizza at this local deli and convenience store.
cards.short_summary: Byrne Dairy is a go-to for students seeking deli sandwiches and grocery essentials late into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Byrne Dairy & Deli in Hamilton offers online ordering for pickup until 9:40 p.m.
cards.source_title: Byrne Dairy & Deli 169 Utica St - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open late for pickup and convenience items; check seasonal hours for midnight closing.

cards.title: Late Dinner at Royal India
cards.subtitle: 6 Broad St, Hamilton
cards.notes: Enjoy a late-night Indian feast with friends at this popular village spot, open until 10:00 p.m. on weekends.
cards.short_summary: Royal India Grill offers a flavorful alternative for students looking for a sit-down meal later in the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Royal India Grill is open until 10:00 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 p.m. on Friday and Saturday; 9:00 p.m. other nights.

cards.title: The Village Subway Run
cards.subtitle: 34 Utica St, Hamilton
cards.notes: Grab a late-night sub sandwich in the village, a reliable option for students after campus dining closes.
cards.short_summary: Located conveniently in the village, Subway provides a familiar late-night sandwich option for the Colgate community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Subway location at 34 Utica St in Hamilton is open until 9:30 p.m.
